    Good modules #

    Predecessors are invariant under isomorphism up to isomorphism (PredN.of_iso). A module is good (Good) if it is nonzero indecomposable, has finitely many predecessors up to isomorphism, and no predecessor lies on a cycle. Good modules are closed under predecessors and isomorphism, have predecessor chains of bounded length, and admit induction over proper predecessors (Good.induction). A class of good modules closed under successors is a preprojective component (preprojComp_good).
